_comment: Prompt categories for run_imagewithprompt.py. Keys are matched against --category. 'default' is the fallback.

symbol_high.positive: high-value game symbol icon, bold jewel or crown design, luxurious, glowing, vibrant gold and purple colors, cartoon game art style, clean transparent edges, polished render, high quality game icon
symbol_high.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted shape, broken silhouette, realistic, photorealistic, ugly, noisy, watermark, text

symbol_low.positive: playing card symbol game icon, A K Q J 10 card letter, cartoon game art style, colorful, clean transparent edges, polished render, high quality game icon
symbol_low.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, realistic, photorealistic, ugly, noisy, watermark, extra symbols

symbol_wild.positive: WILD game symbol icon, bold star or lightning design, glowing aura, highly stylized, vibrant colors, cartoon game art style, clean transparent edges, polished render, high quality game icon
symbol_wild.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, realistic, ugly, noisy, watermark, plain, boring

symbol_scatter.positive: SCATTER or BONUS game symbol icon, special bonus badge design, glowing, exciting, vibrant colors, cartoon game art style, clean transparent edges, polished render, high quality game icon
symbol_scatter.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, realistic, ugly, noisy, watermark, dull

background.positive: cartoon game background scene, wide landscape, colorful painterly environment, polished game art, rich details, atmospheric lighting, high quality game background
background.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, realistic photo, photorealistic, ugly, noisy, watermark, UI elements, icons

character.positive: cartoon game character portrait icon, same pose and composition, expressive face, vibrant colors, clean edges, polished render, high quality game character art
character.negative: blurry, low quality, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, realistic, photorealistic, ugly, watermark

panel.positive: cartoon game UI panel element, clean layout, matching theme, readable design, polished, colorful, high quality game UI art
panel.negative: blurry, unreadable, distorted layout, broken elements, realistic, low quality, ugly, watermark

button.positive: cartoon game button UI element, clean rounded shape, matching theme, polished, colorful, high quality game UI art
button.negative: blurry, distorted, broken shape, realistic, low quality, ugly, watermark

icon.positive: cartoon game icon, clean silhouette, matching art style, vibrant colors, polished render, transparent background, high quality game icon
icon.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted silhouette, realistic, photorealistic, ugly, noisy, watermark

default.positive: cartoon game asset, matching art style, same color palette and mood, clean edges, vibrant colors, polished render, high quality game art
default.negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, realistic, photorealistic, ugly, noisy, watermark
